rows.text: In the land of white ash, the dragon of death, Typhon, brought down a rain of fire. The lava solidified into the first dragon eggs, and thus the Infernalians were born. They built a civilization and revered Typhon as the Father of All Dragons. The worship of fire and blood flows in their veins: Every young dragon must defeat their sire at their coming-of-age ceremony to inherit their fame and wealth, only to be defeated by their own offspring later. This internal strife grew increasingly vicious in Infernalian culture, to the point where some fathers tried to devour their own progeny or prevent them from being born. With the fall of the "Permanence," more dragon eggs have fallen silent. Some were sold across the universe as souvenirs, never to have the chance to hatch.
